result.summary: The page is generally well-designed and visually coherent, but there are a few minor issues: truncated restaurant name text, cut-off horizontal carousel content, and a somewhat ambiguous notification indicator.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel appears truncated, likely cut off at 'Piccolo' without an ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Add text truncation with an ellipsis or allow the name to wrap, so full restaurant names are readable

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right edge with no clear visual affordance indicating horizontal scrolling
issues.suggestion: Partially show the next card intentionally with consistent peeking margins, or add a scroll indicator/dots to hint at more content

issues.description: The notification badge in the top-right is just a small red dot on a grey circle with no count or label, making its purpose unclear
issues.suggestion: Add a notification count or an icon (e.g., bell) to clarify what the red dot represents

issues.description: The last category chip ('All' selected state) uses white text on dark green, which is fine, but adjacent unselected chips have low visual prominence and the row is cut off with no scroll indication
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient contrast for unselected chips and hint at additional categories beyond the visible edge
